Name: Maggs SVE Town Map Fixes for Retexture - fixes base fence end tiles and picnic table delete
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
[b][size=4]What this mod does:[/size][/b]
Patches the fence ends on the SVE town map to match so tile retexture mods, such as the gorgeous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45720]Italian Town Buildings[/url] mod, have the correct base tiles to replace on the fences. This might not work for every retexture mod, so it is fully configurable.

Also included is a patch to remove the picnic tables from the town square for those of you who want to play SVE with farmer's market and other similar mods using the town square area but the graphics conflict.

Each patch option has a configuration toggle so you can turn them on or off depending on what works with your other mods.

This fix is exclusively for the SVE town map, it does not fix any other expansion maps.

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
Simply download and unzip the mod, then drag to your mods folder. It requires Stardew Valley Expanded to work.

[b][size=4]Other mods in the screenshots:[/size][/b]
Italian Town Buildings: ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45720]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45720
[/url]Sweet Farmer: ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53548]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53548[/url]

Thanks to Flashshifter and the amazing Stardew Valley Expanded mod that I can't seem to live without!
